name: ultracode
description: A repo-agnostic agentic engineering pipeline plus a codebase-scouting initializer that generates per-repo skills and a routing inventory for any language or framework.

claude.marketplace_description: Ultracode: a portable agentic engineering pipeline + per-repo skill initializer.

interface.shortDescription: Run a rigorous repository engineering pipeline.
interface.longDescription: Explore, specify, plan, implement, review, test, and document repository changes with specialized agents grounded in the repository's own conventions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Ultracode to plan, implement, review, and verify this repository change.
